summary_1line: After the princes’ birth, Bhishma’s rule brings prosperity to the Kuru realm; Dhritarashtra, Pandu, and Vidura grow into learned and skilled young men.

image_candidates.scene_text: The prosperous city of Hastinapura rises with hundreds of palaces and dark cloudlike gates as joyful citizens gather in markets and gardens.
Young Pandu, Dhritarashtra, and Vidura train in martial arts—archery, mace, sword, and horsemanship—under the watchful care of Bhishma.
Festive Kuru lands filled with fruitful trees, full lakes, and people celebrating sacrifices beneath rows of sacred stakes.
